Latin word

reliquus

reliquus, reliqua, reliquum

adjective, agreeing with its noun

left over, remaining; the rest of, the remaining; the rest of

In this lexicon

  • remain

    also used · classical · Cic. Fam. 9.18.4: mūlō istō, quem tibi reliquum dīcis esse

  • the rest

    the recommended word · classical · Liv. 21.33.1: agmen reliquum; Cato Agr. 2.4: quae reliqua opera sient

  • the top of

    the recommended word · classical · Liv. 21.33.1: agmen reliquum

    then at first light the camp was struck and the rest of the column began to moveLiv. 21.33.1
